title: Node-Wise Dynamic Optimal Control for Evolutionary Games on General Multilayer Networks
summary: Promoting cooperative behaviour amongst decision makers has key implications for the long term sustainability of social systems. Incentives can promote cooperation in situations where defection is more favourable. Previous research has identified optimal decentralised incentives in structured populations where the social environment is described by a generic single-layer networks. Optimality is here intended in the sense of cost minimisation. Here, we provide and optimal incentive strategy for structured populations in general network, a rather unexplored case.
